_comment: Compact Class C motorhome on the regular-cab cab-chassis proxy (render-only). Coach geometry in scripts/variants/class_c.py; all dimensions metres in the cab_chassis variant frame (origin = frame top, 7 cm behind the cab back).
name: class_c
title: Class C motorhome on a heavy-duty regular-cab chassis cab with dual rear wheels (render-only reference cab)
_truck_comment: source hd_reference = the downloaded 1999-2007-generation heavy-duty regular-cab pickup cut behind the cab, with DRW wheels from the derived chassis-cab model (render-only, see README Credits). wheelbase_cc 4.19 m = 165 in, the long 1-ton DRW chassis-cab wheelbase (cab back to rear axle ~2.2 m); with rear_y -4.20 the body is ~7.3 m bumper to rear wall. Fallback: --set truck.source=procedural.
_cameras_comment: door_side 1 = entry door + awning on the passenger/curb side (US). front34 is mirrored to the right-front so the hero view shows the door side; side and rear34 stay on the left (graphics, bike rack).
